caption: AI-assisted learning prototype | Python + Streamlit banking simulation
Invalid login is rejected. Three failures lock an account for 60 seconds.
Dashboard: RM 5,000.00 balance, account navigation and balance chart.
Insufficient funds: RM 9,999 is rejected; the balance stays RM 5,000.
Wrong OTP is rejected; the balance remains RM 5,000.00.
After more than 60 seconds, the OTP expires and no transaction is completed.
Fresh transfer request: RM 100 to Bob. OTP is required before money moves.
Correct OTP completes one transfer. Alice's balance is RM 4,900.00.
Bill payment: select Electricity, Water, Internet or Mobile phone and validate a reference.
OTP-confirmed electricity payment: RM 12.50 deducted. Balance: RM 4,887.50.
Credit card module: validate a fictional 16-digit number and a positive amount.
Credit card payment requires OTP. The confirmation only displays the final four digits.
Credit card payment completed: RM 20.00 deducted. Balance: RM 4,867.50.
Simulated deposit: enter RM 30.00 to increase the account balance.
OTP-confirmed deposit adds RM 30.00. Final balance: RM 4,897.50.
Complete history: transfer, bill payment, credit card payment and deposit are recorded.
History includes credit/debit direction, completed status and each post-transaction balance; CSV export is available.
Balance chart shows the sequence of completed banking activities.
Spending chart summarizes outgoing transfers, bill payments and credit card payments.
Recipient verification: Bob's balance increased from RM 2,500.00 to RM 2,600.00.
Bob's history records the incoming transfer from Alice, with no outgoing payment.
Third failed login locks Charlie's account for 60 seconds.
Even the correct password is rejected until the account lock expires.
Real five-minute inactivity check: automatic logout returned this idle session to the login page.
After the 60-second lock expires, Charlie can log in again with the correct password.
Real server restart: JSON reload preserves Alice's RM 4,897.50 balance and four activities.
Review, understand and adapt this AI-assisted prototype; prepare your own report and demonstration.
